_comment: Nakshatra dasa options per slot (ini arrays of 25, CurrentState): NakshatraDasaStartPoint (seed: 0 Moon, 1 Utpanna, 2 Kshema, 3 Aadhaana, 4 Lagna, 5 Maandi, 6 Gulika, 7 Sookshma TriSphuta, 8 Sun ...), NakshatraDasaShift, NaksDasaADMethodPreference (0..5), AntiZodiacalDasa (Vimsottari). capture.py --ini replaces every line of an array key, so one run sets one slot (Vimsottari 0, Ashtottari 1, Yogini 3, Dwisaptati 4, Dwadasottari 6, Shashtihayani 11); tests/nakshatraOptions.test.ts checks the dasa of that slot. Restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini afterwards. Output: golden/jhora-dasa-options/<variant>/.
